messages.en:
{07 15 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}! I finally found
one, {04 02 00}!

{07 00 00}What, you ask?! {01 00 00 05 00}It's a
crack on the ground! {01 00 00 05 00}Can
you believe it? {01 00 00 05 00}A CRACK!!!
{07 15 00}There's got to be something
fabulous buried here!
messages.et:
{07 15 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}! Ma leidsin lõpuks
ühe, {04 02 00}!

{07 00 00}Mida, sa küsid?! {01 00 00 05 00}See on
pragu maapinnas! {01 00 00 05 00}Kas
suudad uskuda? {01 00 00 05 00}PRAGU!!!
{07 15 00}Siia peab olema maetud
midagi vapustavat!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Hey, {07 0b 00}what do you do when
you find something that
someone lost?{02 00 00 05 06}
Go to Booker!
Pocket it!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Kuule, {07 0b 00}mida sa teed, kui
leiad midagi, mille
keegi kaotas?{02 00 00 05 06}
Lähen Bookeri juurde!
Panen taskusse!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}{ff 00 00 06}Sable {ff 00 00 00}and {ff 00 00 06}Mabel{ff 00 00 00}'s shop has
some cute dresses, I guess.

{07 14 00}But {ff 00 00 06}Gracie{ff 00 00 00}'s dresses are
insanely stylish!

{07 16 00}But even a stylish diva like
me can't get one! What's up
with that, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 06 00}It's the only thing holding
me back from becoming an
A-list celebrity!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}{ff 00 00 06}Sable {ff 00 00 00}ja {ff 00 00 06}Mabeli{ff 00 00 00} poes on
vist mõned nunnud kleidid.

{07 14 00}Aga {ff 00 00 06}Gracie{ff 00 00 00} kleidid on
hullumeelselt stiilsed!

{07 16 00}Aga isegi minusugune stiilne
diiva ei saa ühtegi! Mis lugu
see on, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 06 00}See on ainus asi, mis
takistab mul saada A-klassi
kuulsuseks!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}You're so right!{01 00 00 0a 00} Lost stuff
SHOULD get taken to
{ff 00 00 06}Booker{ff 00 00 00}.
{07 11 00}But I might keep it if
nobody was around and it
was worth tons of Bells{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Sul on nii õigus!{01 00 00 0a 00} Kaotatud
kraam PEAKS minema
{ff 00 00 06}Bookerile{ff 00 00 00}.
{07 11 00}Aga ma võiksin selle endale
jätta, kui kedagi poleks
lähedal ja see kallis{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.

messages.en:
{07 02 00}What?!{01 00 00 0a 00} That's just
wrong, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 06 00}You've got to take lost
stuff to {ff 00 00 06}Copper{ff 00 00 00} and{ff 00 00 06} Booker{ff 00 00 00}!
